info.name: UseCase1 - Generated Scenario Requests
info.description: Deterministic Postman Collection v2.1 created locally from generated scenario endpoint fields. No LLM is used to construct this collection. Only documented scenario endpoints are included.

item.name: Revoked Refresh Token Cannot Be Reused

request.description:
Verify that a revoked refresh token is rejected when used to generate a new access token
Steps: Attempt to use the revoked refresh token to call /token/refresh
Expected: The /token/refresh endpoint returns a 400 response and does not issue a new access token
Source: Use Case1_Validate Token Access and Refresh Token Lifecycle.docx

item.name: Introspected Access Token Returns Valid Status

request.description:
Verify that a valid access token returns an active/introspected status when passed to /token/introspect
Steps: Call /token/introspect with the captured accessToken
Expected: The /token/introspect endpoint returns a 200 response confirming the access token is valid and active
Source: Use Case1_Validate Token Access and Refresh Token Lifecycle.docx
